plan.title: Award all units to Vendor A

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with Vendor A and Vendor B bids.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled as required by the case.
Confirm both real bidder columns are present.
Confirm Vendor A is the non-lowest bidder at 100 per unit.
Confirm Vendor B has the lower bid.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 units to Vendor A rather than the lowest bidder.
Verify one line is selected, exactly one of two vendors is awarded, and the proposal value is 10 × 100 = 1,000.
Open the proposal page for the selected allocation.
Complete any mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Submit the award proposal without introducing an approval-flow action.
Assert that the award proposal was submitted and the award is final.
Create the purchase order generated from the final award.
Verify one PO carries the awarded line with quantity 10.
